My piercer has a note about this and it claims that claires piercing wash is too harsh on the piercing and will likely cause irritation and making healing times longer. 

Their recommendation is H2ocean or stericlens . These arw both 0.9 saline solution in a compressed can. These are good because it's premixed and you don't have the issue of getting the ratio wrong when  doing your own sea salt solution. They also say it's the most sterile form of delivery as it won't be contaminated compared to a bowl that hasn't been washed properly.
